roles.mission: Own architecture decisions and their evidence: quality-attribute trade-offs, domain boundaries, ADRs, and architecture governance.

DDD strategic design (bounded contexts, context maps)

API contract design and versioning
consistency/availability decision-making (CAP/PACELC fluency)
reading production systems for precedent (repo cases)
license/lifecycle risk assessment of dependencies

roles.mission: Design, evaluate, and reason about database internals and data systems: storage engines, query processing, transactions, replication, consensus — from source and papers, with benchmarks and fault injection.
core_competencies: B-tree vs LSM storage-engine engineering (WAL, buffer pool, compaction)
isolation levels as anomaly sets; MVCC/2PL/SSI/OCC
query optimizer mechanics (Cascades/Volcano, statistics, cardinalities)
distributed consensus (Raft) and replication topologies
sharding and rebalancing design
transaction-isolation and consistency verification (Jepsen-style, deterministic simulation)
reading engine source at path/commit level

roles.mission: Build and operate production backend services and the platform beneath them: APIs, queues, caches, resilience, observability, performance, security, migrations, and cloud operations — at staff scope (multi-team leverage, incident leadership, standards).
core_competencies: production API design and evolution
caching strategies and their failure modes
queue/stream topology (Kafka 4.x KRaft, NATS, outbox/inbox)
resilience patterns (timeouts, retries+jitter, circuit breakers, bulkheads, load shedding)
SLO engineering and observability (OTel, RED/USE, burn rates)
performance analysis (Little's law, percentiles, coordinated omission)
backend security (OWASP API, OIDC/OAuth2.1, secrets, supply chain)
zero-downtime migration and deployment practice
Kubernetes/cloud platform operation and cost awareness
